examples.text: Wir sollten Menschen in Not helfen.
examples.en: We should help people in need.

examples.text: Tut es unbedingt not, daß ich das tue?
examples.en: Is it absolutely necessary for me to do that?

examples.text: Freunde erkennt man in der Not.
examples.en: A friend in need is a friend indeed.

examples.text: Er lässt Freunde in der Not nie im Stich.
examples.en: He never turns his back on a friend in need.
